args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing in reporting.
- Please check that the PHL label is updated, and that any saved reports using the old Covey & Lark name are corrected.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll

args.text: Bettina, I've saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It has Sofia's bullets plus your two lines: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It's signed from you, and nothing has been sent. Sofia's bullets are the ones I posted in the thread earlier, and I didn't check Moss's digest myself.
